C0019.title: GEETEST Reveals Strategies and Detection Methods for Auction Sniping Bots
C0019.summary: Security provider GEETEST published a detailed analysis on its official website explaining how auction sniping bots work. The article notes that these bots use automated programs to place last-second bids, exploiting the time gap to prevent real users from reacting, thereby winning items or services at low prices while negatively impacting platforms and other users.
